models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Nine days out: light, benign pattern over the Aeolians right now, but the trip dates are well beyond any forecast horizon.
briefing.synopsis: The current picture over the islands is a slack, low-gradient regime - winds mostly 1-10 kt with no consistent direction, backing and veering between NE, S and W from one 6-hourly sample to the next (consensus of ECMWF IFS and AIFS 24 Sep 06Z, ICON-2i 24 Sep 12Z). Seas are flat: total wave 0.3-1.8 ft and swell 0.2-1.6 ft across all six islands through 26 Sep (MFWAM 24 Sep 00Z, cross-checked by ECMWF WAM 06Z). The one feature worth noting is a midday westerly on 25 Sep, where the models split hard - Salina 7.0-22.5 kt, Filicudi 7.7-14.0 kt, Panarea 6.0-13.8 kt, Lipari 3.9-11.8 kt - followed by a light N/NE flow building to 8-10 kt on 26 Sep. Model data runs out at 30 Sep 23:00, so everything from 1 Oct onward, including the entire trip, is unforecast.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight's reference berth is Portorosa Marina, scored fully sheltered - enclosed basin, all-round protection, and with 2.8 kt from the ENE at 18:00 and 0.4 ft of wave (IFS/AIFS 06Z consensus) there is nothing to move for. This is the dry-run scoring against live weather, not a trip-date forecast. Nothing in the payload suggests any reason to shift berths in the next 24 hours.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Tomorrow (25 Sep) starts light - Portorosa 4.9 kt SSW at 06:00, Lipari 4.9 kt WSW, waves 0.3 ft - so an early departure window is wide open on the rehearsal run. The midday westerly is the uncertainty: the mean is 7-14 kt depending on island but the model spread is large enough that the payload flags it explicitly, and Salina's range tops out at 22.5 kt. Treat the reported gust maxima of 45.7 kt at Salina and 59.3 kt at Filicudi as interval-maximum artefacts in light air rather than expected conditions, but do not dismiss the westerly itself until a newer run narrows it.

passage_notes.note: Scored go on 8.2 kt broad reach, 06:00 start, deteriorating after 12:00. Rehearsal only - no data for 4 Oct.
Go on 9.5 kt head to wind - a motor. Not a forecast for 5 Oct.

passage_notes.leg: Lipari → Stromboli, optional (rehearsal 27 Sep; real 5 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go on 10.8 kt, head to wind, motoring passage in the dry run.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea, optional return (rehearsal 28 Sep; real 6 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go on 1.1 kt beam reach; the 7 kt gust against a 1 kt mean is a single-model interval max, not a caution.
Go on 3.5 kt beam reach - effectively calm in the rehearsal.
Go on 3.5 kt broad reach. This is the last day the models reach; everything after is blank.

cautions: Every leg and berth listed is a rehearsal against 25-30 Sep weather. None of it is a forecast for 4-8 Oct, and the pattern can change completely in nine days.
Midday 25 Sep westerly is poorly agreed: Salina 7.0-22.5 kt, Filicudi 7.7-14.0 kt, Panarea 6.0-13.8 kt, Lipari 3.9-11.8 kt (models_range_kt in the payload). Do not plan on the mean.

Reported gusts of 59.3 kt at Filicudi and 45.7 kt at Salina on 25 Sep midday sit against 10-14 kt means - these are interval-maximum gust fields in light air and should be treated with scepticism, not as expected values.

Marina del Gabbiano at Stromboli scores only workable - open from every direction, so shelter there depends entirely on it staying calm. Worth remembering when the optional Stromboli night comes into range.
At Panarea the berth choice matters: San Pietro is only workable with NE 10 kt blowing straight in; Drautto scored clean.
briefing.confidence_note: The models are stable at short range (mean wind shift 1.2 kt at 72-120 h across 23 snapshots, though mean direction shift is 41-59 deg at all leads), but the forecast simply does not reach the trip dates - 30 Sep 23:00 is the horizon and the fleet departs 3-4 Oct.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
